title: TLS: Handle dissection of KeyExchange in 2nd pass when cipher changes
description:
In TLS 1.2 and below, renegotiation can change the selected cipher.
On subsequent passes, we don't attempt dissection, but we do dissect
the Client and Server Key Exchange differently depending on the
selected cipher. The value in the conversation level session will
have the last value set in the sequential first pass.

Save the cipher in packet data on the first pass so that the KeyEx
can be correctly dissected in later passes even if it changes during
renegotiation.

Related to #18867
